points: This prophecy jumps ahead in time: Paroh is about to attack the Pelishtim, and Yirmiyahu says Bavel, coming from the north, will finish them off.
History agrees: the ancient Philistines were wiped out by the Babylonians.
The ancient Pelishtim have nothing to do with today's Palestinians. The Romans renamed Yehudah "Palestine" after the Bar Kochba revolt, to stick it to the Jews.
The message: all the enemies who attacked the Jewish people will fall too.
"Baldness comes to Azza" may hint at the Egyptians, who shaved their heads to hold on to youth and fight aging. Judaism embraces getting older instead.
